result:
PR #420 still can't fold. Merging master cleared the out-of-date failure, but the new head fails a different selftest check that belongs to another lane's code, so I've posted the PR as blocked.

- **Why attempt 1 didn't finish:** its work was done, audited and pushed at `c048e73280`, but its CI ran before master moved. This worktree was also 63 commits behind its own remote branch. Both points are now in `docs/lanes/pilotgate/NOTES.md`.
- **Merge:** I brought the worktree up to the remote branch and merged `origin/master` with no conflicts. I made no changes to the gate itself. The head is now `a0744f8d26`, and the PR is ready (not draft) and mergeable.
- **What fails now:** exactly one check, `selftest.d/64-status-html.sh:117` "the republished page carries the change" (CI run 36276660235). It comes from the status dashboard's publishing, which this lane doesn't own. The same check fails on `lane/perfregimen` and `lane/claimrace`, and nothing this lane edits is on its path.
- **Local selftest:** 1877 passed, 1 failed, and every pilot-gate check passed. The failing check's name was cut from the local output, so I'm inferring it's the same one CI names.

The `[lane.pilotgate] blocked:` comment on the PR says what unblocks it: a fix to that status-page check lands on master, then someone merges master into this branch and waits for CI to go green. Only then should the `needs-rebase` label be swapped for `fold-ready`; I haven't changed the labels, since CI isn't green yet.
